failed_apis.why_tried: UWP EventHandlerForDevice + Scenario1 register for app suspend/resume to close/reopen the serial device handle across PLM transitions.
failed_apis.root_cause: Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Application does not expose Suspending/Resuming (nor EnteredBackground/LeavingBackground); desktop WinUI 3 apps are not process-lifetime-managed like UWP. Code compiled under UWP now fails CS1061.
failed_apis.fix: Remove the Suspending/Resuming subscriptions; hook the main Window.Closed event (and, if needed, drop the resume path) to release device handles. Keep the existing OnAppSuspension/OnAppResume method bodies but change how they are wired.

special_apis.special_handling: This helper class is copy-pasted verbatim across the entire Windows-universal-samples device-access family (SerialPort/CustomSerialDeviceAccess, Usb/CustomUsbDeviceAccess, CustomHidDeviceAccess, Bluetooth, PointOfService). All of them subscribe to Application.Suspending/Resuming, so the same CS1061 recurs everywhere.

The x:DataType was actually present and correct.
errors_encountered.fix: Resolve the upstream C# compile errors first; the WMC errors then disappear.
